scope: Preserve V8U through V9M, use only the cached V8S kinematic envelope and V9M qualification closure, and specify a labelled three-branch 3D storyboard. V9N does not execute Blender or a solver, does not animate post-contact physics, does not acquire sources, and does not predict force, impulse, rupture, debris, fuel dispersion, facade damage or tower response.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A field read directly from the frozen V8S configuration or results, or from the validated V9M closure result.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: An official NIST value already transcribed in V8S and displayed only with its official-model label.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: None introduced; the source archive is not read or rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: Constant-velocity rigid-silhouette motion before first contact, camera choices, colors, durations and the storyboard layout.
evidence_policy.derived_result: Pre-contact offsets calculated from frozen V8S velocity components and negative event times, plus the shot list and coverage checks.
evidence_policy.contradiction_or_unknown: Any post-contact force, deformation, failure, trajectory or structural response, all of which remain outside the storyboard.

next_iteration.objective: Implement the V9N visualization-only specification as a new bounded Blender scene and low-resolution proof sheet without modifying the existing master file. Animate constant-velocity rigid silhouettes only for negative event times, freeze at first contact, replace every post-contact interval with labelled data cards, and keep the permanent non-physical-validation banner. Do not enable rigid-body, collision, fracture, particle, fuel, fire, structural or solver-driven physics.

interpretation: V9N validates only a visualization specification. Three frozen V8S input envelopes are represented by constant-velocity rigid silhouettes at four non-positive event times. All motion stops at first contact; later timing is shown on a data card only. Eleven shots, five cameras, five overlay requirements and eight provenance items are defined, with zero post-contact motion shots. No Blender or solver process is executed, and no physical facade, rupture, debris, fuel, fire or tower-response claim is made.

runtime.software: Python standard-library deterministic cached storyboard synthesis
